parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: Configuration ID.

parameters.name: DnsRecord
parameters.description: Rewrite the DNS resolution record of the origin request.

parameters.name: Follow302Enable
parameters.description:
302 redirection toggle. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Follow302MaxTries
parameters.description: Maximum number of 302 redirect attempts. Valid values: [1–5].

parameters.name: Follow302RetainArgs
parameters.description:
Toggle to retain original request parameters. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Follow302RetainHeader
parameters.description:
Toggle to retain original request headers. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Follow302TargetHost
parameters.description: The origin host after a 302 redirect is modified.

parameters.name: OriginHost
parameters.description: The HOST carried in the origin request.

parameters.name: OriginHttpPort
parameters.description: Port of the origin server when using HTTP protocol for origin pull.

parameters.name: OriginHttpsPort
parameters.description: Port of the origin server when using HTTPS protocol for origin pull.

parameters.name: OriginMtls
parameters.description:
mTLS switch. Valid values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: OriginReadTimeout
parameters.description: Origin read timeout (seconds).

parameters.name: OriginScheme
parameters.description:
Protocol used for the origin request. Valid values:
- http: Use HTTP protocol for origin pull.
- https: Use HTTPS protocol for origin pull.
- follow: Follow the client's protocol for origin pull.

parameters.name: OriginSni
parameters.description: SNI carried in the origin request.

parameters.name: OriginVerify
parameters.description:
Origin certificate verification switch. Valid values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description:
Use range chunking for origin pull file download. Valid values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.
- force: Force.

parameters.name: RangeChunkSize
parameters.description:
Range shard size. Valid values:
- 512 KB
- 1 MB
- 2 MB
- 4 MB

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
Rule content, used to match user requests with conditional expressions. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. There are two usage scenarios:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true
- Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Rule switch. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enable.
- off: Disable.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: Rule name. This parameter is not required when adding a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: Rule execution order. Rules with smaller numeric values are executed first.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) interface.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa update-origin-rule --site-id 54074984130000 --config-id 352816096980000 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --origin-host origin.example.com --origin-scheme http --origin-sni origin.example.com --dns-record test.example.com --origin-http-port 8080 --origin-https-port 4433 --range on --origin-mtls on --origin-verify on --range-chunk-size 1MB --sequence 1 --origin-read-timeout 10 --follow-302-enable on --follow-302-max-tries 1 --follow-302-retain-args on --follow-302-retain-header on --follow-302-target-host test.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UpdateOriginRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 54074984130000 --Follow302MaxTries 1 --RuleEnable on --OriginHttpsPort 4433 --Follow302RetainArgs on --OriginScheme http --Sequence 1 --Follow302RetainHeader on --Range on --RangeChunkSize 1MB --OriginReadTimeout 10 --OriginHost 'origin.example.com' --OriginHttpPort 8080 --OriginMtls on --Follow302TargetHost 'test.com' --OriginSni 'origin.example.com' --ConfigId 352816096980000 --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --DnsRecord 'test.example.com' --Follow302Enable on --RuleName rule_example --OriginVerify on
